correctness.rationale: For unrestricted deterministic k-symbol feedback, existence iff every pair of equal cyclic k-factors has identical next symbol; thus M=1+max length of equal factors with different successors. With nonzero support {0,d}, unequal symbols preclude matching nonzero contexts, while equal symbols with d<L permit one aligned spike and at most 2d-1 common letters; the zero-run conflict has length L-2. The antipodal same-symbol word has primitive period d. These sharp witnesses yield M=max(L-1,2d),L-1,d-1,d in the four cases stated. Cyclic pair counts n for d<n/2 and n/2 for d=n/2 prove the entire q-ary polynomial for all n>=4. The d=1 boundary and smaller-period exception are included.
